title: HEALPix on both

dataset.name: DKRZ WCRP hackathon ICON d3hp003, P1D mean, HEALPix z7, atmosphere (Zarr)

left.label: ours (ortho-cog-viewer)
left.note: No cell renderer. The mesh/UV warp renderer takes a raster with a CRS and a geotransform; a HEALPix array is a 1D list of cells with no image to warp.

gap: We have no path from a DGGS or unstructured grid to the screen; gridlook treats the grid as the primitive and draws cells directly.
bridge: HEALPix cell centres through delaunay into our mesh renderer (same trick gridlook uses for ICON), or a HEALPix-to-tile-scheme step in grout/aatgrid so the warp renderer sees a raster.
